title: Why Cats Bring Dead Animals Home
topic: Why do cats bring you dead animals?

lines: Ever wonder why your cat drops dead birds at your feet?

beats.title: Natural hunter
lines: Cats are solitary hunters by nature, and even indoor felines keep the instinct to stalk and kill small prey.
Researchers think they present the catch to humans as a social gift, sharing surplus food like members of a pack.
Even male cats do it, showing it isn’t just teaching kittens.

beats.title: What gets delivered?
lines: The gift is most often small prey like birds or rodents; larger animals are harder to carry, so they’re less likely to be offered.
You can satisfy that drive with interactive toys, letting the cat hunt safely and reducing unwanted deliveries.
Next time they bring a gift, offer a feather wand instead.

sources.claim: Cats present prey to humans as a social gift, sharing excess kill.
Male cats also bring prey, indicating it isn’t only teaching kittens.
Cats retain hunting instinct even when indoor.
